description: This file defines functions for traversing and inspecting a markdown document tree, including block and inline elements, with depth-first traversal methods.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Interface representing a markdown block element.

classes.name: Inline
classes.description: Interface representing a markdown inline element.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents the root document node containing child blocks.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Represents a list block containing list items.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: Represents an item within a list.

methods.name: Inspect
methods.description: Traverses the markdown tree in depth-first order, applying function f to each node.

methods.name: InspectBlock
methods.description: Traverses block elements in depth-first order, applying function f.

methods.name: InspectInline
methods.description: Traverses inline elements in depth-first order, applying function f.
